jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Modeling), Risk
jobs.description: As part of the Risk ML team, you will build machine learning models that detect fraudulent activity in real time and help keep our customers safe and secure. You will experiment with state-of-the-art algorithms to drive down false positives, collaborate on new product features to drive fraud losses down, use any and every dataset at your disposal to analyse emerging fraud patterns, engineer new features for risk models, and deploy robust models to take action on bad activity in real time.

jobs.title: ServiceNow AI Engineer
jobs.description: The ServiceNow AI Engineer is responsible for designing, configuring and optimising Now Assist AI features (e.g., case summarisation, agent assistance and knowledge solutions) and builds high-quality prompts, instructions and model configurations using organisational data. The role implements and monitors AI safety controls (e.g., guardrails, filtering and compliance checks), integrates ServiceNow with external systems, and analyses performance to reduce hallucinations and improve accuracy.

jobs.title: Graduate Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: The AI Products group builds products that use AI and ML to reduce toil and deliver insights, with the role being part of a diverse, globally distributed Data & Science team of scientists, engineers, product managers, and analysts. Machine Learning Engineers design and build infrastructure and services that power AI products, and work closely with Applied Scientists through research and development to safely move models from research to production environments.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Deep Learning & Computer Vision
jobs.description: You will contribute to developing Medical AI products, with work spanning the entire product lifecycle from early R&D efforts to writing production code, supporting clinical evidence generation, and contributing to regulatory documentation. Model development will involve building, refining, deploying, and evaluating vision classification and segmentation models.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
jobs.description: Joining a multidisciplinary team of software engineers and data scientists to help build and manage the systems that facilitate efficient and trustworthy experimentation across millions of consumer interactions across the Rokt global network. These systems enable partners, marketplace brands and internal teams to scientifically surface insights into consumer behaviour, validate hypotheses, and steer strategic decisions.

jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher – Equities/Futures
jobs.description: Responsible for performing large scale data analysis to derive statistically profitable predictions of market behaviour. These predictions are used to inform all of our trading, and improvements have a high and visible impact across the office. Requirements include strong programming experience in at least one language, and mainstream deep learning framework (TensorFlow, PyTorch or other) and deep understanding of the strengths & weaknesses of CNN, RNN, LSTM and transformers.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – ANZ Plus
jobs.description: Designing and implementing scalable AI solutions that enable data engineers and ML scientists to train, build and maintain machine learning models effectively, developing automated processes for continuous model training and evaluation pipelines specifically for ML applications, and ensuring the seamless integration of ANZ Plus's current architecture with newly added ML functionalities.

jobs.title: Specialist Data Scientist
jobs.description: BHP's Performance and Data Analytics team is responsible for undertaking analysis and providing insights to drive maintenance productivity and performance across our assets, with activities ranging from identifying maintenance performance gaps, deriving actionable insights, formulating strategies and implementing improvement projects. The Specialist Data Scientist will work collaboratively alongside other data scientists, performance and improvement specialists, and operations and business subject matter experts to level up BHP's maintenance productivity.

jobs.title: 大模型应用开发工程师
jobs.description: 极智嘉2026届全球校园招聘，软件类岗位包括大模型应用方向，涵盖AI工具开发、大模型应用落地、ROS中间件开发等技术栈，提供极具市场竞争力的薪酬福利及全球化发展平台。

jobs.title: 推荐算法工程师实习
jobs.description: Research and development of recommendation algorithms for Shopee's overseas e-commerce products, including recall, ranking, re-ranking, and mixed ranking optimization throughout the entire recommendation pipeline. The role requires deep understanding of how e-commerce business intersects with machine learning, optimizing models and recommendation strategies to improve overall e-commerce objectives.

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习（空间AI）
jobs.description: Engaging in dialogue understanding research to enhance accurate interpretation of complex language expressions; participating in LLM agent development to optimize synergistic interaction between agents and large language models; assisting with agent planning work to improve decision-making and task execution; and conducting semantic rejection research to accurately identify and handle invalid or non-target semantics.

jobs.title: 数据开发工程师（26届校招）
jobs.description: Participate in enterprise-level data platform construction, responsible for full-chain development of data collection, storage, computation, and visualization; dive deep into business scenarios, participate in data model design and optimization to improve data quality and computational efficiency; participate in AI data product design and development.

jobs.title: AI Agent 研发实习生（2026届）
jobs.description: Requires proficiency in Python, understanding of mainstream large models (GPT-4, Claude 3.5, Gemini, DeepSeek), and familiarity with Agent development frameworks. Internship requires at least 3 days per week for 6+ months in Shenzhen.

jobs.title: AI大模型算法工程师
jobs.description: 负责AI模型相关研发工作，包括垂直领域大模型微调，模型评估及迭代，RAG及Agent等，支持垂直行业应用落地；参与垂直领域行业大模型应用场景落地，包括但不限于Text2SQL、Text2Chart、智能对话、智能推理等。

jobs.title: 通用模型岗
jobs.description: 负责大模型增量预训练、高效微调、推理优化和效果评估等，并在工业领域场景中实现落地；利用自然语言处理、深度学习在海量文本处理及挖掘中的应用，包括信息抽取，意图识别，文本相关度模型，知识图谱构建，语义理解等；追踪NLP/多模态等大模型前沿技术。

jobs.title: 预测算法工程师
jobs.description: Responsible for behavior intention/trajectory prediction related algorithm research and implementation for objects (vehicles/pedestrians/bicycles) in autonomous driving scenarios. Deep research into deep learning or machine learning algorithms with understanding of common algorithms and optimization methods; strong Python/C++ programming fundamentals with basic data structures and algorithms; experience with machine learning platforms like PyTorch/TensorFlow.

jobs.title: 研发工程师-C++/大模型开发【转正实习】
jobs.description: Participating in the architecture design and construction of large-scale distributed machine learning platforms related to generative models; participating in large-scale massive data offline training and online inference to improve model prediction accuracy and real-time performance; deep collaboration with algorithm departments for joint optimization of algorithms and systems; proficient in C++/Python with ability to write high-quality code and optimize algorithms, and have actual project experience in machine learning and deep learning.

jobs.title: 算法工程师（2026届校招）
jobs.description: 越疆机器人2026届疆才计划校园招聘，研发类岗位涵盖算法工程师方向，包括强化学习/运动规划/路径规划/动力学/模仿学习等专业方向。越疆是中国协作机器人第一股，全球领先的智能机器人研发制造商，连续六年协作机器人出口量第1，产品销往100多个国家。算法类年度薪酬为25W-45W。
